subject: Clear Signal 001: ChatGPT now works with your iPhone mail and calendar
preheader: One change worth knowing, one prompt to try today, and four quick hits. Five minutes.
hello: AI can feel like a lot. Clear Signal keeps it simple: one change worth knowing, one prompt you can use today, and a few quick hits. Five minutes, then back to your clients.

oneThing.title: ChatGPT now works with your iPhone mail and calendar

points.label: What it is
points.text: If your day runs on iCloud, you can now connect ChatGPT to your iCloud Mail and Calendar. It can find an email, draft a reply, and add or move appointments when you ask.

points.label: Try this
points.text: Ask: "What showings do I have Thursday, and which buyers haven't heard from me this week?"

points.label: The fine print
points.text: You switch it on yourself, with a special app password from Apple. It can send email, so read every message before it goes. It sees iCloud mail only, not Gmail or Outlook.

field.question: "Is it safe to put client info into AI?"
field.answer: Treat a chat like a shared notepad, not a vault. Keep names, addresses and money details out unless your brokerage has approved the tool, and use a temporary chat for anything sensitive so it isn't saved.

quickHits.title: Better flyers in Canva
quickHits.text: Canva's new image maker, Craft, plans the layout before it draws, so your headline lands where you want it. Label any edited listing photo.

quickHits.title: Closing dates to your calendar
quickHits.text: Agenda Hero turns a pasted email, screenshot or PDF timeline into calendar events, and you check them before anything is added.

quickHits.title: A lead tracker from your inbox
quickHits.text: The Neuron shared a Zapier recipe that pulls names, dates and next steps from labeled Gmail messages into a Google Sheet, then reminds you to follow up.

quickHits.title: Watch for fake AI apps
quickHits.text: Knock-off ChatGPT and Claude desktop apps have been caught secretly running crypto-mining software. Download only from the company's own site or the official app store.
